rendered_html:
Questions people ask

How much does the website cost?

£1,200 is the total. There's no VAT to add and nothing else gets tacked on later. That figure covers the whole build, not a starting price that grows once you're in the door.

What does 'you only pay if you like it' actually mean?

We build the site first and send you a private preview link. You look at it properly, on your phone and on your computer, before you pay anything. If you're happy, you accept it and pay then. If you're not, you walk away and owe us nothing.

How long does it take?

Usually three or four days once we have what we need from you. We'll give you a firm date after we've seen your domain and heard what your business does, and if we can't hit it, we'll tell you before you've paid anything, not after.

What do you need from me to get started?

Not much. Tell us your domain and what your business does, and we'll take it from there. If you've got a preference on wording or images, send them over, but we can write the pages ourselves if you'd rather leave that to us.

What if I don't like the finished site?

You get a full refund, no questions, right up until the moment you accept it. Accepting means telling us it's ready to go live, so nothing is final until you say so.

What happens after I accept the site?

The site goes live and from that point any changes you ask for are charged separately. If something's wrong because of a mistake we made, we fix it at no cost to you. That's different from asking for something new.

Do I need to know anything technical?

No. Hosting just means the space online where your site actually lives, and that's the only term you really need. You don't need to know how any of it works behind the scenes, that's the part we handle.

Is there a contract or an ongoing fee?

No monthly fee to us and no tie-in of any kind. You pay the one-off price once, the site is yours, and that's the end of the arrangement unless you want more work later.

rendered_html:
Questions we get asked

How much does it cost?

We agree one fixed price with you before any work starts, and that's the total. There's no VAT added on top and no monthly fee once the site is live. If you want changes after you've accepted the site, those are quoted separately and charged as work.

How long does it take?

Usually three or four days from having what we need from you: your logo, your content, and a clear idea of the pages you want. If you're slow sending things over, the timeline moves with you.

What if I don't like the finished site?

You get a private preview link before anything goes live, so you see the actual site rather than a sketch of it. You have 14 days from receiving that link to accept it, ask for changes, or decline for a refund of what you paid, minus a £75 deposit that covers our costs in building the site. Once you accept the site, or once the 14 days run out, whichever happens first, the refund right closes.

How many rounds of changes do I get?

Two rounds of revisions are included in the fixed price. Anything beyond that is extra work, and we tell you the price before we do it, not after.

What happens if I need changes after the site is live?

Changes made after acceptance are charged as work, priced upfront so there's no surprise. If something is wrong because of a mistake we made, we fix it at no cost.

Do I need to write the text myself?

No. We write the page copy as well as build the pages, so you don't need to hand us finished text. Send over whatever you've got, even if it's rough, and we'll take it from there.

Is there a contract or a monthly fee?

No. You pay once and there's nothing you're locked into afterwards. There's no subscription running in the background and nothing that stops working if you don't pay again next month.

What about the domain and hosting?

A domain is the address people type to find your site, and hosting is where the site's files actually live. You don't need to understand either of those to get a working website. We handle the setup as part of getting the site live, so it's ready to visit by the time you see it.

What do you need from me to get started?

A bit about your business, what you'd like the site to do, and any existing material such as a logo or old website. Tell us as much or as little as you know. You can send an email to webdesign@contactforsales.com or call +44 (0) 7934 524 911 and we'll talk it through. See /how-it-works.html for what happens step by step, and /what-you-get.html for exactly what's included.

Can I ask a question before I commit to anything?

Yes. Get in touch by email or phone and ask whatever you need to ask before deciding anything. There's no form to fill in and no obligation attached to asking.
